issues.description: Inconsistent parameter type for PersonService.deletePerson: the problem statement and the REST API describe and implement deletion by UUID (DELETE /persons/{personId} — PersonResource.deletePerson(@PathVariable UUID personId) calls personService.deletePerson(personId)). The template PersonService exposes: public void deletePerson(UUID personId) (template/src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java lines 33-35). The solution's PersonService however defines: public void deletePerson(Person person) (solution/src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java lines 35-37). Because PersonResource in the solution calls personService.deletePerson(personId) (solution/src/server/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java lines 45-48), the mismatched parameter types (UUID vs Person) create a compile error and confuse students about the intended API for deleting persons.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the service API consistent with the REST contract and problem statement. Preferred fix: change PersonService in the solution to public void deletePerson(UUID personId) and implement deletion by matching IDs (e.g. persons.removeIf(p -> p.getId().equals(personId))). Ensure PersonResource calls personService.deletePerson(personId). If deleting by Person is desired instead, update PersonResource to resolve the Person and call deletePerson(Person) and update the problem statement and tests accordingly — but the simpler and least disruptive solution is to accept UUID in the service.
